findings.text: Halvard Analytics has posted a job for a Revenue Operations Manager, which suggests they are building out ownership of revenue processes.

output.angle: With a seat-plus-overage model billed monthly and new Revenue Operations Manager and Billing Analyst roles open, Halvard is staffing up its billing function now and may be weighing how much of that monthly work to handle with people versus software.

facts.text: Moved from flat plans to usage-based pricing for its API.
Open roles include Billing Analyst and Senior Accountant

findings.text: Brightline Freight has moved its API from flat plans to usage-based pricing.
Usage-based pricing means bills now depend on how much each customer uses the API, which is a different billing setup from charging the same flat plan price each period.
The company is hiring a Billing Analyst and a Senior Accountant.
Taken together, the pricing change and the billing and accounting hires suggest the finance team is putting effort into billing right now.

output.angle: Brightline Freight just switched its API to usage-based pricing and is hiring for billing and accounting roles, so its finance team is likely working out how to bill on usage now.
